title: Chef Josh Boutwood returns to Boracay for 3-night culinary residency
summary: Two-Michelin-starred chef Josh Boutwood is returning to Boracay for a special three-night culinary residency at Rima Treetop Dining at Shangri-La Boracay from November 25 to 27.
